Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Redwood + Auriga Health — AWS co-sell intake & next steps

Tim — great to connect at Re:Health last week. I'm Soojin on Redwood's GTM partnerships team; we run co-sell intake and account handoffs alongside AWS. AWS suggested an intro so we can map a short mutual action plan and identify any procurement/security gating items before a technical deep-dive.

High level ask: a 30–45m kickoff with your product and procurement leads to align on timelines and success criteria for an initial pilot. Suggested agenda:
- Introductions & objectives (5m)
- Current use case and expected throughput (10m)
- AWS co-sell / marketplace path & commercial options (10m)
- Open asks: security/PCI/HIPAA scope, procurement timing, preferred SLAs (10m)
- Next steps / owners (5m)

Can you share who on the Auriga side should join (product lead, procurement contact)? I copied Karthik and Laura from our solutions team and Jordan from our sales ops to help drive the plan afterward. If it helps, here's a Calendly link to propose times: https://calendly.com/redwood/auriga-kickoff

Attachments: none on this note.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference on hosted, dedicated, and private deployments

Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood + Auriga Health — AWS co-sell intake & next steps

Soojin — thanks for the note and the agenda, looks good. Please loop in our product lead Maria Alvarez (maria.alvarez@aurigahealth.com) and procurement (procurement@aurigahealth.com) — I've CC'd procurement and asked Maria to suggest available times.

Quick context for the call: we are evaluating a proof-of-concept to accelerate clinician note summarization and secure embeddings storage; expected Q1 pilot with ~15k monthly active users, spike patterns around 9a-11a PT. Security is the primary gating factor (HIPAA + third-party audit).

I can join the kickoff but will defer technical details to Maria and her engineer Ben (copied separately after this thread). Can we aim for next week?

—Tim

Prep from our side: we'll bring a short mutual action plan template and a lightweight architecture sketch so we can quickly surface security/hosting options (hosted API vs. Dedicated vs. Private VPC). Attaching the MA Plan draft and the sketch after we lock time.

Agenda note (slightly expanded):
- 5m: intros + pilot goals (Auriga)
- 10m: expected workflows & data ingress (Auriga product)
- 10m: possible deployment & compliance paths (Redwood + AWS)
- 10m: procurement timing, DocuSign pipeline, and pricing expectations (Redwood/AWS)
- 10m: owners, deadlines, and immediate next 30-day actions (mutual action plan)

If Monday at 10 works for Maria that would be ideal; we can always follow with a technical deep-dive with your engineers.

Thanks —
Soojin
